request.text: The first route is carried out for \(\mathbf G\) in \cref{sec:p02-w02b-p02-001-g-completeness}: \cref{thm:p02-w02b-p02-001-g-completeness} proves that every valid sequent that separates its variables has a derivation in \(\mathbf G\), and \cref{thm:p02-w02b-p02-001-g-cut-elimination} derives 4.14 for those sequents.
